title: Upper mass bound M_W(T) ≤ μ_R(W)
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and R = (M, θ, ξ) : IMRep U n with R.Represents T, i.e. T(ω) = R.action ω for all ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then M_W(T) ≤ μ_R(W) in [0, ∞] for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P. Here μ_R = R.measure, and M_W(T) = T.massOn W is the supremum of ofReal T(ω) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and covectorEuclideanNorm (ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W ≤ R.measure W
